- Multiple seeds with pink/purple discoloration on portions of their seed coats
- Some seeds entirely purple/violet, others partially stained, some appear normal yellow
- The staining varies from specks to large blotches

This strongly points to **Purple_Seed_Stain**. Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference image confirms: seeds showing the same pink-to-purple discoloration pattern mixed with normal yellow seeds — identical to the test image. The partial purple staining across varying seeds, ranging from specks to full coverage, is the hallmark of Purple_Seed_Stain.
